subject: [PATCH v9 23/32] mm/madvise: skip PMD swap entries for MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of PMD swap entries in the Linux kernel's madvise function, specifically for MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT operations. It skips over swapped-out THPs (Transparent Huge Pages) that have no resident folio to deactivate or reclaim, avoiding unnecessary work and potential warnings. The approach taken is to add a check for PMD swap entries at the beginning of the madvise_cold_or_pageout_pte_range function, allowing it to return immediately if such an entry is found.
